result.summary: Triaged the three blockers surfaced by Step 3 verification: GH-366 (regression of ISS-0107 fix at helpers.zig:99; same root cause class as ISS-0107 rework-1, second acquire site not previously bracketed), GH-374 (Windows bare `python3` resolves to Microsoft Store AppExecutionAlias; new pure-environment defect, single-file test fix), GH-359 (pre-existing ISS-0101 latent landmine; long-lived db_test container still carries stray tenant_default.schema_migrations shadow table, env-only cleanup required, no source change). Recommended safe sequential order: GH-359 (env) → GH-374 (test fix) → GH-366 (helper fix), then redispatch Step 3 / TEST-RUNNER Step 5 for fresh full-suite green. All three should land inline on the current feature/WF03-gh364-20260801 branch (no nested branches) — files do not overlap, change surface is tiny per blocker, and the branch is already the canonical home for the #364 + blocker-fix chain. No source, build, test, or migration changes implemented by this triage handoff.

issues.description: Recurrence of closed ISS-0107 fix fc5884b at a different acquire site (helpers.zig:99 `runMigrations` lock). 44 55P03 + 2 40P01 occurrences in fresh full-suite run. Recommended fix: bracket line-99 acquire with SET lock_timeout = `90s` / `5s` matching the proven ISS-0107 rework-1 pattern at line 487. Affected file: tests/integration/helpers.zig (1 file, ~4 lines).

tests/integration/tnt_schema_isolation_test.zig TC-TNT-02-03/04 launch bare `python3` which resolves to Microsoft Store AppExecutionAlias on Windows (exit 49). Recommended fix: replace argv with helper-resolved interpreter (.venv\Scripts\python.exe with BPM_TEST_PYTHON override, fallback to bare python3 for non-Windows). Affected file: tests/integration/tnt_schema_isolation_test.zig (lines 591-593 and 659-661, 4-6 lines).

Pre-existing ISS-0101 latent landmine: long-lived db_test container carries stray tenant_default.schema_migrations shadow table from before migration tracking consolidated onto public.schema_migrations. Symptom: 23505 on schema_migrations_schema_version_uq + `relation "events" does not exist` from shadow-table-resolution. Recommended fix: pure environment cleanup `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tenant_default.schema_migrations;` against BPM_TEST_DB_URL, no source change. ISS-0101 already open on GitHub.
